The '''Schiav'''<ref name="Droids Reanimated 2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Standing at over two meters tall, they were distinguished by their tan-colored skin, long brown hair and two fangs projecting upward from their bottom jaws.<ref name="TNK">{{DroidsCite|The New King}}</ref>

The [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jyn Obah]] was a Schiav.<ref name="Droids Reanimated 2" />
